answer: Distance-bounded trust horizon resists sybils: trust is granted only within a bounded hop-distance of the honest seed on the vouch graph, and anything beyond the horizon counts as zero regardless of internal structure. An inlet of fakes pushed past the trust horizon by a long attack chain receives nothing; the lotus-close honest core sits well inside it. A jade-dense sybil mesh far from the seed cannot pull itself inside the horizon without genuine short-range honest vouches, which a bulk farm behind a thin edge bundle structurally lacks.
